description.value: Otreat is a Korean-influenced brunch cafe tucked into a commercial complex in Langley, serving a creative menu of coffee drinks, mimosa flights, mocktails, and hearty brunch plates alongside dishes like Gochujang Bulgogi wings and chicken benny. The menu is updated regularly and the waitlist feature on the site signals a popular local destination. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect a full sit-down brunch experience with both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverage options.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (6 spaces, covered) at 44m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content at otreat.ca confirms the business is a brunch cafe at #509 - 8840 210st Langley, matching the OSM address exactly. The menu page (updated MAY.30.2026) shows an active, operating establishment with coffee, brunch food, cocktails, and mocktails. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags; OSM confirms outdoor seating but nothing cycling-related.
